_comment: EVER-ISSUED edge_id ledger (spec M-evolution-essence-graph §5 R12, ADR-0177 D7). Consumed by evals/evolution-content-integrity.eval.mjs. Semantics differ deliberately from the species_id/quest_id append-only baselines: R12 permits an edge to be REMOVED, but an edge_id SHALL NEVER be reused or reassigned to a different (from, to). So this is a MAP, not a list. Rules: a live edge_id missing here -> FAIL (append it consciously); a live edge_id whose from/to differs from its entry here -> FAIL (reassignment); an entry here with no live edge -> OK, it is retired, and the entry is NEVER deleted. Hand-derived by reading game-core/content/evolution_paths/000-core.ron directly (EG5-1), then cross-checked against parseEdgeIdLiterals - a baseline generated FROM the extractor under test is self-confirming and forbidden.
